decision.reopen_trigger: Replace this pre-decision package only when the RBNZ publishes the OCR/MPS, corrects its schedule, or a subsequent independently verified event produces a different non-directional NZD/USD calculation question.
decision.rationale: The dated RBNZ page and Reuters' current independent preview satisfy the two-publisher, freshness and fact gates. The calendar provides an observable current discovery path, while PipGauge naturally answers the explicit NZD/USD fixed-risk arithmetic. No existing package is NZD/USD/RBNZ-specific, so this is new rather than a same-calculator duplicate; no rate, policy or currency outcome is asserted.
